maddeler.e:
تبخترت (form IIq)
# تَبَخْتَرْتُ (tabaḵtartu) /ta.bax.tar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
# تَبَخْتَرْتَ (tabaḵtarta) /ta.bax.tar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
# تَبَخْتَرْتِ (tabaḵtarti) /ta.bax.tar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
# تَبَخْتَرَتْ (tabaḵtarat) /ta.bax.ta.rat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
